baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possession question, repeated partner noun, consequential imperative, and conditional truth clause form one test: لهم شركاء ... فليأتوا بشركائهم ... صادقين.
baseline_models.mechanism: An asserted relationship is made falsifiable. Joint participants must cross from alleged possession into presence, so enacted fulfillment rather than assertion alone establishes the claim.

activation_trace.role: Sharing and partnership supplies jointly participating parties as the object of the possession claim.
Coming and arriving makes the imperative a demand that the alleged parties become present.
Being or occurrence in time supplies the condition that the claimed relationship must actually obtain.
Confirmation and fulfillment makes truth testable by what the claimants can produce.

changed_reading.before: The ayah asks whether they have partners and challenges the truth of their answer.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a public production test: an alleged partnership counts only if its members can actually appear and fulfill the claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural partners are possessed jointly, are commanded to be brought, and occur inside a condition built with كانوا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The partnership can distribute responsibility as well as association. A form-distant surety branch under كانوا lets the conditional subjects be heard as persons who stand behind an undertaking; bringing them then means producing co-guarantors whose performance confirms the claim.

activation_trace.role: Shared participation supplies several parties capable of carrying one undertaking together.
Bringing or delivering supplies the procedural production of those jointly responsible.
Suretyship or undertaking responsibility activates a liability-bearing edge beneath the ordinary copular form.
Fulfillment turns a verbal undertaking into demonstrated reliability.

changed_reading.before: The partners are merely allies named by the claimants.
changed_reading.after: The partners can also be co-sureties: bring the persons willing and able to underwrite the claim in action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same partner root occurs twice around an imperative of arrival, while truth is predicated of the plural claimants.
baseline_models.mechanism: A divided or preoccupied opinion makes partnership intrapsychic without erasing the plural grammar. The command externalizes competing counsels and demands that the voices behind the claim arrive in public correspondence with what is said.

activation_trace.role: A divided or self-preoccupied opinion supplies rival counsels beneath the social noun.
Arrival gives those latent counsels a demanded transition into observable speech or presence.
Truth as correspondence among speech, inner belief, and reported reality tests whether the counsels cohere.

changed_reading.after: Partners may additionally expose a divided counsel: make every voice underwriting the claim come forward and correspond with reality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated partner root can retain its normal social reading while also activating its material image of branching road tracks beside an imperative of approach.
baseline_models.mechanism: Partnership has an infrastructural underside: multiple tracks claim to provide access. The imperative asks that the alleged routes be laid out, and truth becomes the solidity and straightness of the way they actually furnish.

activation_trace.role: Main and branching road tracks materialize the partners as a network of claimed access routes.
Approaching a matter through its proper access makes route viability the function of the imperative.
Solidity and straightness supplies the material criterion by which the proposed route is tested.

changed_reading.before: The challenge concerns only whether associated agents exist.
changed_reading.after: The challenge also asks whether the branching supports behind the claim form a real, straight, traversable way.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding questions build a forensic ladder: judgment, a binding written record, an oath reaching its term, and an accountable guarantor precede the demand for partners. The focus imperative therefore operates like production of parties in support of a pleaded entitlement.

activation_trace.role: Joint participation supplies the co-parties whose alleged standing must be established.
Arrival turns evidentiary support into the physical production of parties.
Confirmation through fulfillment makes the pleaded claim answerable to performance.
Judgment between people supplies the adjudicative setting for testing the claim.
A written determination that imposes judgment supplies the putative documentary authority.
A binding oath supplies another asserted legal basis whose reach is challenged.
Undertaking suretyship gives the immediately preceding spokesman an accountable rather than merely vocal role.

structural_cues: The repeated أم لكم questions move from a book in 68:37 to oaths in 68:39 and partners in 68:41, while 68:40 inserts a singular accountable figure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies judgment, binding writing, oath, suretyship, and then the focus imperative; I infer escalation from asserted entitlement to production of accountable parties. A live alternative is a sequence of rhetorical denials with no formal courtroom procedure.

changed_reading.before: The imperative is a general challenge to make alleged partners appear.
changed_reading.after: The imperative is the final evidentiary step in a claim: produce the co-parties who can authenticate the document, oath, judgment, and entitlement being asserted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guarantee and liability recur across the context, with the singular guarantor directly before the focus plural. This repetition strengthens the focus-only possibility that partners are not decorative allies but co-sureties who must stand behind consequences that eventually catch up with the undertaking.

activation_trace.role: Shared participation distributes one undertaking across several responsible parties.
Suretyship beneath the conditional form keeps joint liability live inside the focus wording.
Fulfillment makes a surety credible only when the undertaking is carried through.
Guaranteeing and undertaking responsibility supplies an earlier model of one party answering for something.
Suretyship makes the preceding زعيم a direct bridge from representation to liability.
Bearing suretyship and remaining bound supplies the endurance required of a responsible guarantor.
Consequent liability or guarantee that catches up supplies the eventual reach of the undertaking.

structural_cues: The singular زعيم in 68:40 is followed immediately by plural شركاء in 68:41, changing number while preserving accountable backing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several guarantee images and their adjacency to the focus; I infer that the plural partners distribute the singular guarantor's burden. The alternative is that زعيم is only a leader or spokesman and that the remote guarantee branches do not govern كانوا.

changed_reading.before: Joint suretyship is only a form-distant possibility within the focus roots.
changed_reading.after: The context turns it into a recurrent liability pattern: produce every co-surety willing to answer for the claim when its consequence arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden sequence couples withholding with apportionment, exclusion of a poor entrant, and reversal into deprivation; later financial liability is described as clinging. Against that sequence, partnership can denote a shared portion as well as co-persons, and bringing the partners can carry the demand to render the excluded share or produce its co-claimants.

activation_trace.role: Shared possession and a common portion supplies an economic stake inside the social partnership.
Giving or bringing permits the imperative to concern delivery as well as bodily arrival.
Charity and relinquishing a right makes truthful conduct visible in how a material claim is yielded.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the initiating distributive failure.
Separating and apportioning a share makes division of the garden's yield structurally available.
Destitution supplies the excluded claimant whose entry the owners seek to block.
Deprivation and missing the desired thing reverses the owners' planned exclusion back onto them.
An adhering financial liability supplies the possibility that a denied share remains due.

structural_cues: In 68:17-27 the owners move collectively, bar a poor person from entering, and then name themselves deprived, creating a reciprocal exclusion pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, division, poverty, deprivation, and financial liability; I infer that a common share creates a co-claimant whose exclusion rebounds on the possessors. The live alternative, favored by the animate plural grammar, is that only persons are to be brought and no transfer of a share is implied.

changed_reading.before: Bring the alleged partner-persons as proof.
changed_reading.after: Also render the shared due or produce its excluded co-claimants; truth is tested by whether claimed partnership survives distribution rather than hoarding.

context_deltas.mechanism: Companionship becomes assembly, face-to-face grouping, reciprocal blame, and finally summons. That social sequence changes the focus partners from abstract associates into a coalition whose reality is measured by whether its members assemble, answer, and bear responsibility together.

activation_trace.role: Partnership supplies a coalition formed by mutual participation rather than mere naming.
Arrival tests whether the coalition can assemble when called into accountability.
Sincere friendship supplies loyalty as the relational dimension of truth under pressure.
Companionship and sustained association supplies the garden owners as a durable social unit.
The gathering or council of a people turns mutual calling into coalition assembly.
A group facing one another supplies the spatial form of collective reckoning.
Mutual blame exposes how shared action fractures when responsibility becomes costly.
Calling by speech supplies the later public summons that the coalition cannot answer effectively.

structural_cues: The garden group's plural movement ends in reciprocal blame in 68:30, and 68:42-43 repeats a plural call followed by inability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies companionship, assembly, facing, blame, and summons; I infer that the focus tests the operational solidarity of a claimed coalition. An alternative is that the garden group only illustrates failure and does not specify the identity of the focus partners.

changed_reading.before: Partners are counted by asserted affiliation.
changed_reading.after: Partners are counted by accountable solidarity: they must assemble, answer, and continue to share the burden when the claim is tested.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies an oath extending to a named day, a summons on that day, gradual taking, and deliberate respite. These cues temporalize the focus: the imperative is a deadline-bearing summons, and delayed nonappearance becomes evidence rather than escape.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arriving supplies the event whose occurrence can be awaited and tested.
Temporal predication lets the truth condition extend across the interval before appearance.
Fulfillment makes arrival at the appointed test the confirmation of the claim.
Reaching an endpoint supplies the terminal force of the oath's stated horizon.
A delimited duration supplies the named temporal boundary for the asserted entitlement.
A spoken summons supplies the event that converts waiting into demanded response.
Taking degree by degree supplies a staged approach rather than instant resolution.
Respite and extension of the term supplies purposeful delay before the claim is resolved.

structural_cues: Verse 68:39 sends the asserted oaths to a named day; 68:42 opens on that day and immediately describes a call that cannot be answered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies endpoint, day, summons, gradation, and respite; I infer that the focus imperative establishes an appointment whose deferred enforcement exposes falsehood. The alternative is that the imperative is only an immediate rhetorical impossibility and the later day is a separate scene.

changed_reading.before: Bring the partners now or concede the claim.
changed_reading.after: The challenge functions as a summons with an enforceable horizon: respite leaves the claim open until the appointed call makes presence or absence decisive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly moves between inward saying, a mind divided among courses, hearing or understanding, recollection, and a label of covered intellect. This psycholinguistic chain strengthens the possibility that the focus partners are competing counsels forced into accountable public speech.

activation_trace.role: A divided or preoccupied opinion supplies the focus model's competing internal counsels.
Arrival makes latent counsel answerable by requiring it to emerge into public presence.
Correspondence among utterance, inner conviction, and reported object supplies the coherence test.
Unexpressed inner saying supplies a voice that can remain hidden behind an outward claim.
A mind distributed among several courses directly activates internal plurality and indecision.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the possible integration that the final speakers resist.
Recollection after forgetting supplies content that returns to consciousness and demands response.
Covering the intellect supplies the speakers' counter-label for a mind they refuse to recognize as coherent.

structural_cues: Repeated قالوا scenes culminate in 68:51 with hearing the reminder immediately followed by saying that its bearer is mad.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divided opinion, inner speech, understanding, recollection, and covered intellect; I infer that external partners can also project rival internal commitments. The alternative is that these speech and cognition cues describe different actors while the focus partners remain wholly external beings.

changed_reading.before: The divided-counsel branch is an isolated focus-level word image.
changed_reading.after: The wider speech sequence makes the imperative an externalization test: bring forward every counsel behind the claim and see whether speech, conviction, and reality agree.

context_deltas.mechanism: A path is followed by smoothing, gradual movement, plotting, counter-solidity, and eventual loss of footing. These ordered textures turn the focus's branching tracks into an adversarial route: the claimed supports look traversable, but bringing them into operation reveals whether they terminate in stable access or dislodgement.

activation_trace.role: Main and branching road tracks supply the material network beneath the alleged partners.
Proper access to a matter supplies route completion as the imperative's practical demand.
Straightness and solidity supplies stable footing as the material truth criterion.
An extended traversed path supplies the larger directional field in which partner tracks operate.
A smooth road materializes conciliatory softening as apparently easy but potentially unstable footing.
Movement degree by degree supplies the staged traversal of the route.
Plotting and contrivance supplies the adversarial design embedded in the route.
Extended solidity supplies the counter-image of a route whose strength persists.
Slipping from one's station on ground that will not hold a foot supplies the route's terminal instability.

structural_cues: The movement lexicon runs from a path in 68:7 through gradual drawing in 68:44 to attempted dislodgement in 68:51, with the focus challenge inside that trajectory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, smoothness, gradation, plot, solidity, and slipping; I infer one adversarial topology in which claimed support routes are tested by traversal. The alternative is that these are independent lexical images and that the focus partners have no spatial function.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains a latent test of branching tracks as possible access routes.
changed_reading.after: The context turns those tracks into a staged contest of footing: operate the routes behind the claim and their apparent smoothness may disclose dislodgement rather than arrival.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus noun normally presents persons, while the activated image is a hunter's snare. It remains anchored in the repeated ش ر ك root and is reinforced by contextual plotting, exposure of defect, and unstable footing; the reader supplies the reversal by which producing the trusted trap exposes or catches its setters. Downstream prose should retain it only as exploratory material wordplay, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated شركاء can carry a snare-image beneath its social surface, and فليأتوا commands that the alleged supports be brought into the test.

activation_trace.role: A hunter's snare supplies an entangling material underside to the alleged partners.
Bringing the snare into presence converts hidden contrivance into inspectable operation.
Solidity and straightness tests whether the entangling support can bear the claim made for it.
Exposure of a thing and its defect supplies the unveiling of the trap's actual operation.
A contrived plot supplies the intentional design that makes the snare more than a static object.
Loss of footing supplies the bodily consequence of relying on the unstable contrivance.

changed_reading.before: Bring the allies who support the claim.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, bring the snares on which the claim relies; once exposed in operation, the apparatus of capture becomes a test that can unseat its own setters.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant but not unanchored: the focus inventory explicitly carries affinal partnership, and the context activates wealth, sons, attached lineage, and a non-dominant kinship-loyalty mapping. The reader infers that status claims seek backing from an extended patronage household; a live alternative is ordinary divine associates with no kin structure. Downstream prose should label this a social-network possibility, not lexical disambiguation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus twice names their شركاء and demands their arrival, allowing the affinal branch to test whether claimed status has a real household network behind it.

activation_trace.role: Affinal partnership supplies in-laws or marriage-linked patrons as a surprising social specification of the partners.
An outsider living among another people supplies the movement by which an affinal member enters a different household.
Sincere friendship supplies loyal support as the truth test of the claimed relation.
A person attached onto a people supplies contested incorporation into a status group.
Possessing abundant wealth supplies the material status around which patronage can gather.
Sonship, lineage, and attribution to an origin supplies the household axis of the network.
Kinship, clientage, and neighboring loyalty from the non-dominant mapped inventory supplies the wider patronage bond.

changed_reading.before: Partners are undifferentiated supernatural or social supporters.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are the in-law and patronage network claimed by wealth-and-lineage status; the command tests whether that household backing will actually appear.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it couples a social plural with road-track and watercourse images. It remains anchored in the focus roots for branching tracks, directed flow, and solidity, while the context supplies rain, cultivation, channel apertures, a basin, and premature discharge. The reader infers a delivery network whose truth is measured by successful flow; downstream prose should present it only as an ecological-material analogy, never as the direct sense of شركاء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins branching-track imagery in ش ر ك to a watercourse image in ء ت ي and then tests the result by the solidity image in ص د ق.

activation_trace.role: Main and branching tracks supplies a distributary network beneath the partner relation.
A watercourse directed toward a basin supplies delivery through the branching network.
Solidity and straightness supplies channel integrity as the material truth test.
Rain descending between cloud and earth supplies the incoming water that a delivery network would route.
Sowing and cultivation supplies the productive destination dependent on managed flow.
Apertures that hold or regulate a watercourse supplies the control points of the network.
Collected water and its basin supplies successful reception at the end of delivery.
Discharging water or a load before it becomes established supplies failed delivery and loss of retention.

changed_reading.before: Bring the partner-agents who supposedly make the claim effective.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, make the claimed branching network deliver its flow: successful arrival at the basin substantiates it, while blocked or premature discharge defeats it.

strongest_changes: A bare challenge to alleged associates became a forensic production sequence involving judgment, record, oath, guarantor, and co-parties.
The focus-only surety edge became a recurrent model of distributed liability, while the garden sequence opened a separate test of shared portions and withheld due.
The imperative acquired a temporal horizon: respite preserves the summons until a named day makes response or nonresponse decisive.
Social partners remained primary, but divided counsel, unstable tracks, snares, affinal patronage, and hydraulic delivery survived as distinct contained activations.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated partner noun became a hinge between relation and proof. Context did not simply identify the partners; it changed what bringing them would do: authenticate a claim, distribute liability, expose solidarity, render a share, meet a deadline, externalize counsel, or test a route.
remaining_uncertainties: The legal sequence may be a forensic analogy rather than a literal procedural scene.
The distributive reading must preserve the animate plural grammar even when a shared portion becomes active.
The surety reading depends partly on form-distant branches beneath كانوا and neighboring roots.
The psychological and material outliers may be lexical resonance rather than operative senses, so they should coexist without displacing the social reading.
